name: std::basic_spanbuf<CharT,Traits>::swap
intro:
Swaps the state of *this and rhs.

Calls std::basic_streambuf<Char, Traits>::swap(rhs), swaps the open mode of *this and rhs, and then makes them use the underlying buffer of each other.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function is called automatically when swapping stream objects, it is rarely necessary to call it directly.

summary: Swaps the state of *this and rhs.

recommendedExamples.title: Related example: std::basic_ospanstream
recommendedExamples.input: Read or write a number using a fixed 16-character buffer that outlives the stream.
